# Aromatik Apartments

> Eight boutique holiday apartments in the Barri Vell (old town) of Girona, Catalonia, Spain, at Rambla de la Llibertat 11 and 26. Booked directly at https://aromatik.apartments with no commission. Also Aromatik House, a country house with a private pool near Peratallada (Empordà).

Facts on this page come from the owner and were last checked in November 2026.

## Key facts

- Location: Rambla de la Llibertat 11 and 26, 17004 Girona, in the pedestrian old town, beside the river Onyar.
- Check-in from 15:00, check-out before 11:00. Self check-in with a door code, 24 hours a day. No keys.
- Both buildings have a lift.
- Pets are welcome in all eight apartments (tell us when booking).
- Phone, answered 24 hours: +34 930 30 82 09. WhatsApp: +34 682 636 848. Email: hola@aromatik.apartments
- Guest ratings (November 2026): Airbnb 4.71/5 from 2,495 reviews, Google 4.6/5 from 74 reviews, Booking.com 8.4/10 from 122 reviews.
- The website is available in Spanish, English, Catalan, French, German, Chinese, Korean, Portuguese and Dutch.

## For cyclists

- Bikes are kept inside the apartment, not in the street: 4 bikes in Bergamota and in Árbol de té, 2 in each of the other six apartments.
- Both buildings have a lift and a bike fits inside it.
- Bike boxes and bike bags stay inside the apartment during the stay.
- Washing machine in Bergamota, Árbol de té and Geranio. Full kitchen in every apartment.
- Nearest bike workshop and bike wash: Muc-Off Performance Lab by Velodrom, Carrer de l'Argenteria 9, about 150 metres away.
- Classic rides start from the door: Els Àngels, Rocacorba, the lake of Banyoles, the Carrilet greenways to Olot and to Sant Feliu de Guíxols, and the Costa Brava over Les Gavarres.
- Page for cyclists: https://aromatik.apartments/en/ciclistas (Spanish: https://aromatik.apartments/ciclistas)
